(কাস্টমস)

প্রজ্ঞাপন

তারিখ : ২২ জ্যৈষ্ঠ, ১৪২১ বঙ্গাব্দ/০৫ জুন, ২০১৪ খ্রিস্টাব্দ।

National Board of Revenue: The National Board of Revenue is the authorized government body responsible for issuing customs notifications in Bangladesh.
Ministry of Finance: The Ministry of Finance serves as the overarching government entity overseeing the Internal Resources Division and related tax-governing bodies.
Internal Resources Division: The Internal Resources Division functions as a department under the Ministry of Finance responsible for the administration of tax and customs policies.

এস,আর,ও নং- ১৩৯-আইন/২০১৪/২৫০৩/কাস্টমস ।- Customs Act, 1969 (Act No. IV of 1969) এর section 207 ও section 219 এবং THIRD SCHEDULE এর Item 21 এর সহিত পঠিতব্য, এ প্রদত্ত ক্ষমতাবলে, জাতীয় রাজস্ব বোর্ড, ফ্রেইট ফরওয়ার্ডার্স (লাইসেন্সিং ও কার্য-পরিচালনা) বিধিমালা, ২০০৮ এর নিম্নরূপ অধিকতর সংশোধন করিল, যথা :-

উপরি-উক্ত বিধিমালা-

Customs Act 1969: This Act provides the statutory authority under its sections and schedules for the National Board of Revenue to issue or amend regulations relating to customs licensing and operational procedures.
National Board of Revenue: The Board is empowered by the Customs Act to amend and formulate specific rules governing the licensing and operations of freight forwarders.
Freight Forwarders (Licensing and Operat: These rules are subject to further amendment by the National Board of Revenue under the powers granted by the Customs Act.
Third Schedule: The Third Schedule is referenced alongside specific sections of the Customs Act as the legal basis for the National Board of Revenue to issue these amendments.

Bonded Warehouse Operation: The rules governing the operation are amended to include a copy of the Value Added Tax registration certificate as a required document.
The requirements for document submission are updated to mandate the inclusion of certified copies of national identity cards for directors.
The documentation requirements are expanded to include national identity card copies for managing directors, chief executive officers, and all other directors.
